narrative.overview: The ground is warm noir. On it, one filmed drone take falls from the blue-hour sky above Wörthersee to a concrete studio with a single red slit, through a corridor and onto Rustam in a burgundy quarter-zip. A cotton GURBANOV the width of the screen passes behind him. Then a square-cornered cotton sheet slides up over the film and the page becomes a personnel file: ruled rows of six works in Archivo capitals, one italic Newsreader line, tabular figures, and Inter metadata as quiet as a stamp. Red appears as events only: the progress rule, a hovered row, the one bar in the mark, the "Get in touch" pill. Someone shown ten portfolios would recognise this one by the slit-red line under a black film and the ruled cream index that follows it.

rules.name: The One-Take Rule
rules.body: The hero is one continuous camera move. No cut, dissolve or crossfade happens inside it, and every join is frame-locked before the frames are cut.

rules.name: The Sheet Rule
rules.body: Everything after the hero sits on one cotton sheet inset 16 px (8 px on phone) from the noir page, with hairlines dividing the bands. Only the noir statement aside, portraits and the two wordmarks run past a text column.

rules.name: The Rank Rule
rules.body: From Convenium: within a page, a section head is never smaller than a numeral, a stat figure or a label. That is why figures cap at 56 px and section heads reach 64 px. The only type above a section head is the page H1 (the hero wordmark on home, the name on `/cv/`) and the footer wordmark.

rules.name: The Text-Zoom Note
rules.body: Every fluid size carries a rem term (WCAG 1.4.4). The hero wordmark is the one vw-only size, because it is fitted to its container. Its accessible name is the H1's `aria-label` (`hero.h1Aria`), and full-page zoom still scales it.

rules.name: The Three-Red Rule
rules.body: Cherry selects, maroon deepens, chili signals. The roles are not interchangeable.

rules.name: The Mark Exception
rules.body: The RG mark's one cherry bar sits on noir at 1.64:1, so it reads as a dark-red slit among cotton bars, which is the portal in miniature. The mark is a logotype, `aria-hidden`, and carries no information, so WCAG 1.4.11 does not apply. This is the only place cherry may sit on noir.

rules.name: The Real-Pixels Rule
rules.body: Work media is deterministic capture of the live sites; the Remotion films are made from those captures. Nothing is mocked up, and no reference board ships as a page image.

rules.name: The Opacity-and-Transform Rule
rules.body: Reveals move opacity and transform only, never `autoAlpha`, `visibility`, `display` or `content-visibility`. SplitText keeps the whole line in the accessibility tree (`aria: "auto"`).
